text: Which plasma-cell-specific genes (single-cell) encode blood-secreted proteins, T-cell receptor genes excluded?
plan: Cell type category (scRNA): Plasma cells / Cell type enriched AND Secretome annotation: Secreted to blood AND NOT Protein class: T-cell receptor genes
understanding: The question asks to find genes specific to plasma cells based on single-cell RNA data, which encode proteins secreted into the blood, while excluding T-cell receptor genes.

trail.why: The requirement asks for plasma-cell-specific genes in single-cell data, which corresponds to selecting 'Plasma cells' at Level 1 and 'Cell type enriched' (defined as at least four-fold higher mRNA level in a particular cell type compared to any other cell type) at Level 2.
The question specifically asks for genes that encode blood-secreted proteins, which corresponds directly to the 'Secreted to blood' category.
The requirement specifies selecting all T-cell receptor genes for exclusion without restricting by subclass.

requirements.why: It defines RNA specificity and distribution across single cell types (single-cell RNA-seq), with an option for 'Plasma cells'.
It classifies predicted secreted proteins by destination, specifically providing the option 'Secreted to blood'.
